title: Senior Business Intelligence Engineer
description:
Overview

Why should you join dLocal? dLocal enables the biggest companies in the world to collect payments in 40 countries in emerging markets. Global brands rely on us to increase conversion rates and simplify payment expansion effortlessly. As both a payments processor and a merchant of record where we operate, we make it possible for our merchants to make inroads into the world’s fastest-growing, emerging markets. By joining us you will be a part of an amazing global team that makes it all happen, in a flexible, remote-first dynamic culture with travel, health and learning benefits, among others. Being a part of dLocal means working with 1000+ teammates from 30+ different nationalities and developing an international career that impacts millions of people’s daily lives. We are builders, we never run from a challenge, we are customer-centric, and if this sounds like you, we know you will thrive in our team.

What’s the opportunity?

We are looking for an Analytics Engineer to join our Business Intelligence team, with a strong focus on data pipelines, predictive analytics and dashboarding. The ideal candidate will join a team that takes full responsibility for designing, developing and maintaining the Business Intelligence and Advanced Analytics platform: from designing ETLs and scalable data models to applying advanced statistical and machine learning methods, and building interactive dashboards that drive decision-making across the company.

What will I be doing?

  • Implement and maintain data pipelines, ensuring data quality, consistency and scalability across the BI and Advanced Analytics platforms.
  • Detect and correct errors in our BI Platform and processes in order to guarantee reliability.
  • Translate business requirements into predictive models, dashboards, simulations, and analytical frameworks.
  • Design and implement forecasting solutions (time series, ML-based predictors) to anticipate trends in payment volumes, revenues, and customer behavior.
  • Develop and deploy machine learning models into production pipelines.
  • Hands-on analysis, design and development of interactive dashboards and data visualizations that combine descriptive, diagnostic, and predictive insights.
  • Build automated reporting and alerting solutions, integrating predictive and real-time metrics.
  • Ensure timeliness, resilience, availability and accessibility of data.
  • Maintain and extend documentation of BI & ML architecture, processes, and procedures.
  • Stay up-to-date with industry standards, forecasting techniques, visualization best practices, and ML frameworks.
  • Contribute to the definition of standards and best practices for data science, analytics engineering, and dashboarding.
  • Work closely with Data Engineers, Analysts, and Product teams to deliver robust predictive and visualization solutions.

What skills do I need?

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in Analytics Engineering / Data Science.
  • Strong expertise in SQL (Redshift, PostgreSQL, MySQL).
  • Solid knowledge of data modeling, ETL processes, and cloud data platforms (AWS / GCP: EMR, Lambda, EC2, S3, Athena, Redshift).
  • Experience with forecasting techniques (ARIMA, Prophet, exponential smoothing, machine learning regressors, deep learning models).
  • Proficiency in Python (Pandas, Scikit-learn, Statsmodels, PyTorch/TensorFlow is a plus).
  • Familiarity with Spark for large-scale data processing.
  • Experience with Airflow, DBT, DataHub, Github.
  • Strong understanding of statistical modeling, feature engineering, and predictive analytics.
  • Proven experience building dashboards and data visualizations (Looker, Power BI, Tableau or similar), with ability to translate data into actionable insights and compelling stories.
  • Analytical and problem-solving skills with a holistic approach to business and data.
  • Excellent written and spoken English.
  • Ability to translate complex user requirements into technical, predictive, and visualization solutions.
  • Curious mindset, ability to learn new technologies quickly.
  • Ability to work independently as well as in cross-functional teams.

What do we offer?

  • Remote work: work from anywhere or one of our offices around the globe!
  • Flexibility: we have flexible schedules and we are driven by performance.
  • Fintech industry: work in a dynamic and ever-evolving environment, with plenty to build and boost your creativity.
  • Referral bonus program: our internal talents are the best recruiters - refer someone ideal for a role and get rewarded.
  • Learning & development: get access to a Premium Coursera subscription.
  • Language classes: we provide free English, Spanish, or Portuguese classes.
  • Social budget: you\'ll get a monthly budget to chill out with your team (in person or remotely) and deepen your connections!
  • dLocal Houses: want to rent a house to spend one week anywhere in the world coworking with your team? We’ve got your back!

*For people based in Montevideo (Uruguay) applying to non-IT roles, 55% monthly attendance to the office is required

What happens after you apply?

Our Talent Acquisition team is invested in creating the best candidate experience possible, so don’t worry, you will definitely hear from us. We will review your CV and keep you posted by email at every step of the process!

Also, you can check out our webpage, Linkedin, Instagram, and Youtube for more about dLocal!

Graphic Designer (Position located in Sao Paulo, Brazil)

About KnowBe4

KnowBe4, the provider of the world's largest security awareness training and simulated phishing platform, is used by tens of thousands of organizations around the globe. KnowBe4 enables organizations to manage the ongoing problem of social engineering by helping them train employees to make smarter security decisions, every day.

Fortune has ranked us as a best place to work for women, for millennials, and in technology for four years in a row! We have been certified as a "Great Place To Work" in 8 countries, plus we've earned numerous other prestigious awards, including Glassdoor's Best Places To Work.

Our team values radical transparency, extreme ownership, and continuous professional development in a welcoming workplace that encourages all employees to be themselves. Whether working remotely or in-person, we strive to make every day fun and engaging; from team lunches to trivia competitions to local outings, there is always something exciting happening at KnowBe4.

The Graphic Designer conceptualizes storyboard information and then relays it with creative illustrations and graphical elements into comprehensive layouts for animation with the goal of enhancing the learner’s ability to grasp the information. The individual in this role can/will create high-quality visual assets (artwork & videos) leveraging AI tools and technologies. You will consistently research e-learning and design trends to keep the courses fresh year after year. The graphic designer has a good eye for detail when reviewing assets for consistency throughout development and also helps oversee production and deadlines. When working on projects for other KnowBe4 publishers, the graphic designer will emulate the design of the publisher's other content. The ideal candidate should be an AI enthusiast with a passion for leveraging artificial intelligence to transform learning experiences. You will work together with other eLearning developers, QA and engineers in a fast-paced environment using product/project management tools and developing standards for partners.

  • Creative problem-solving and adaptability
  • Collaborates effectively with a creative team to integrate AI-generated and human-created design elements
  • Works with the instructional designer’s content to create graphics that reflect the objectives clearly, as well as the publisher’s graphics style, leveraging AI design tools while maintaining consistency
  • Effectively develop and refine prompts to achieve specific AI image and video designs that will be used as assets in elearning modules
  • Enhance AI-generated visuals using traditional design software
  • Develops storyboard layouts incorporating VO and AI-generated visual components

  • Evaluate and curate AI-generated content for quality, accuracy, and alignment with project objectives that abide by copyright and intellectual property considerations before integration into courses
  • Document best practices; research and recommend improvements to AI content creation workflows to enhance quality and efficiency
  • Create templates and frameworks that can be consistently applied when using AI writing tools and assist publishers in utilising them

Requirements:

  • BA, BFA or comparable work/life experience
  • A minimum of 5 years of graphic design experience
  • Full knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite
  • Experience with Gmail and Google Docs
  • Experience with MS Office (Word and Excel)
  • Experience in creating training guides, educational materials, infographics and graphic animations
  • Experience with AI tools (ie...ElevenLabs, Google Veo 3, HeyGen, Synthesia Midjourney AI, RunwayML,ect.)
  • Strong verbal and written communications
  • Ability to give clear feedback to other team members
  • Excellent time management and organization skills
  • Ability to prompt, create and integrate AI-generated elements seamlessly with human-created content
  • Knowledge of best practices for AI content creation and curation in design
  • Adaptability and openness to evolving AI capabilities and applications in eLearning
  • A critical eye for ensuring AI-generated content maintains consistency and quality standards

We are seeking highly qualified professionals with a Master’s or PhD in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs).   • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.
  • Familiarity with laboratory procedures, microbiological instrumentation, and interpretation of diagnostic test results (e.g., blood cultures, PCR, AST).

Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world\'s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine. By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we\'re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms. Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.

About The Role

We are seeking highly qualified professionals with (Master\'s or PhD) in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs). As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will play a critical role in shaping how AI understands and communicates complex biomedical knowledge, with a specific focus on microbiological sciences. This role involves evaluating AI-generated responses for scientific accuracy, contextual integrity, and clinical relevance within the field of medical microbiology. Your feedback and annotations will inform the improvement of AI systems used in healthcare education, diagnostics support, public health communication, and biomedical research.

Key Responsibilities

  • Critically assess AI-generated responses in topics including microbial taxonomy, infectious disease mechanisms, host–pathogen interactions, diagnostic microbiology, antimicrobial resistance, and laboratory methodologies.
  • Apply structured annotation to texts, including labelling for scientific correctness, terminology accuracy, logical structure, and clinical relevance.
  • Categorize model outputs using domain-specific taxonomies (e.g., pathogen type, disease process, diagnostic method).
  • Create real-world clinical or laboratory scenarios with researchers to design and test prompts to assess the model\'s reasoning and adaptability to professional contexts (e.g., interpreting culture reports, recommending diagnostic tests, understanding resistance profiles).

Required Qualifications

  • Master\'s or PhD in Medical Microbiology, Immunology, or a closely related biomedical discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.
  • Familiarity with laboratory procedures, microbiological instrumentation, and interpretation of diagnostic test results (e.g., blood cultures, PCR, AST).
  • Excellent written communication skills and fluency in English.
  • As part of the project, you are required to complete the English language assessment. The assessment is mandatory & non-billable.

Overview

Job summary

We have the opportunity for an enthusiastic midwife to cover this position for 09 months.

The post holder will act as an expert practitioner, resource and role model in order to develop and maintain an effective clinical learning environment, using clinical evidence to facilitate 'best practice'. They will provide line management, leadership and support to the practice development teams across the Trust to ensure women, birthing people and their families receive quality care at all times.

Interview date TBC

Main duties

The post holder will work closely with the senior midwifery team and the lead obstetricians for education to ensure all standards are achieved, and a robust process is in place to meet all governance agendas. Supporting the leadership strategy to ensure that the needs of women and birthing people are placed at the centre of care and service delivery. This will include the review/development of clinical guidelines, implementing midwifery practice development plans and actions in response to risk case reviews and clinical supervision reviews. They will action and implement national and local recommendations in relation to clinical practice updates and training. The post holder will maintain a training data base recording all statutory and mandatory training and act as the main point of contact for HEI providers in relation to student commissioning and any issues in clinical practice. As a member of the senior midwifery team the post holder will form part of the senior midwifery on-call service and undertake directorate and trust wide projects as required.

Chelsea and Westminster Hospital NHS Foundation Trust is one of England\'s top-performing and safest trusts. We operate two main acute hospital sites--Chelsea and Westminster Hospital and West Middlesex University Hospital--along with award-winning clinics across North West London.

Our nearly 7,500 staff care for a diverse population of 1.5 million, providing full clinical services, including maternity, A&E, and children\'s services, plus specialist HIV and sexual health clinics. The Care Quality Commission rates us \'Good\' in safety, effectiveness, care, and responsiveness, and \'Outstanding\' in leadership and resource use.

We continually invest in our facilities, including a £30m expansion of critical care at Chelsea and Westminster and an £80m Ambulatory Diagnostic Centre at West Middlesex.

We are committed to equal opportunities and believe that diversity drives innovation and excellence. As part of our dedication to equity, we actively welcome applications from individuals from the global majority, veterans and underrepresented communities. We value the unique perspectives and experiences that diverse teams bring and are committed to creating an environment where all voices are heard, respected, and empowered to succeed.

If you haven\'t heard from us within three weeks of the closing date, your application was likely unsuccessful. Employment is subject to a six-month probationary period.

Some roles may require weekend shifts at multiple sites.

SEE JOB DESCRIPTION ATTACHED FOR FULL INFORMATION.

  • Promote and lead respective activity e.g. clinical supervision, journal clubs etc., to enhance development.

About The Role

We are seeking highly qualified professionals with (Master's or PhD) in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs). As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will play a critical role in shaping how AI understands and communicates complex biomedical knowledge, with a specific focus on microbiological sciences.

This role involves evaluating AI-generated responses for scientific accuracy, contextual integrity, and clinical relevance within the field of medical microbiology. Your feedback and annotations will inform the improvement of AI systems used in healthcare education, diagnostics support, public health communication, and biomedical research.

Key Responsibilities

  • Critically assess AI-generated responses in topics including microbial taxonomy, infectious disease mechanisms, host–pathogen interactions, diagnostic microbiology, antimicrobial resistance, and laboratory methodologies.
  • Apply structured annotation to texts, including labeling for scientific correctness, terminology accuracy, logical structure, and clinical relevance.
  • Categorize model outputs using domain-specific taxonomies (e.g., pathogen type, disease process, diagnostic method).
  • Create real-world clinical or laboratory scenarios with researchers to design and test prompts to assess the model's reasoning and adaptability to professional contexts (e.g., interpreting culture reports, recommending diagnostic tests, understanding resistance profiles).

Required Qualifications

  • Master's or PhD in Medical Microbiology, Immunology, or a closely related biomedical discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.
  • Familiarity with laboratory procedures, microbiological instrumentation, and interpretation of diagnostic test results (e.g., blood cultures, PCR, AST).
  • Excellent written communication skills and fluency in English.

description:
Graphic Designer & Video Editor

Are you the kind of creative who rewatchs TikToks and Reels to study the edits? Who can spot a high-performing hook in three seconds flat—and knows how to make it better?

We’re looking for someone ambitious, fast-moving, and creatively sharp—a designer/editor hybrid who wants to grow their skills and career inside a clean beauty brand that’s scaling quickly. If you’re scrappy, self-motivated, and obsessed with making content that stops the scroll, this is for you.

This role is all about creating high-converting, elevated visuals—especially TikTok-style video ads with a polished, modern feel. Think: beauty brand meets performance creative. Your designs should look expensive, feel on-trend, and perform like hell.

You’ll own:

  • Ad creative (priority #1): Design and edit short-form, engaging, both TikTok-style and high-end videos, and static ads for Meta, Instagram, YouTube, TV, and TikTok Shop.
  • Email design: Build visually compelling emails that feel editorial but drive conversion. We use Klaviyo & Figma.
  • Site & app assets: Homepage features, product page visuals, mobile banners, and app store graphics.
  • SMS & promo graphics: Banners, popups, and assets that elevate the brand experience.
  • Media buyer support: Work closely with our performance team to test creatives, iterate fast, and optimize what’s working

Must-haves:

  • Video editing is a requirement. You must be confident in creating UGC-style, jump-cut, text-overlay video ads designed for TikTok, Reels, and paid social.
  • Luxury-meets-conversion design skills. You can make things look polished and high-end without overdesigning.
  • 3+ years of experience in graphic design and video editing (bonus if you’ve worked in eComm or beauty).
  • Fluent in Adobe Suite and Figma. Bonus if you know CapCut, Premiere, or After Effects.
  • A portfolio that shows smart, effective work—especially ad creative that performs

Best Fit If:

  • You love clean beauty, skincare, wellness, or a non-toxic lifestyle.
  • You’re obsessed with TikTok and Instagram trends and can adapt fast.
  • You understand CPM, CTR, ROAS, and MER—and design with those goals in mind.
  • You don’t need hand-holding. You love autonomy, and you’re proud of your hustle.
  • You’ve used creative ops tools like Air, Notion, or Asana.

Seniority level: Mid-Senior level

Employment type: Full-time

Job function: Design, Art/Creative, and Information Technology

Industries: Internet Publishing

title: Sales Operations and Salesforce Administrator (OTE $80,000/year USD), Sparkrock
description:
Are you passionate about Salesforce, automation, and leveraging AI to supercharge business workflows? Do you thrive at the intersection of technology, operations, and sales strategy?

At Sparkrock, we help social benefit organizations—like nonprofits, school boards, and government agencies—reach their greatest potential through technology. Every day, over 150,000 people use our ERP and product platforms to work more efficiently, freeing up time and resources to focus on the good they want to achieve.

We are seeking a Sales Operations and Salesforce/Certinia Admin to manage Salesforce and Certinia to support business requirements. This role also includes owning financial management system configuration and integrations with marketing, accounting, sales engagement, and document management platforms while ensuring data integrity and optimizing workflows. The manager will partner with Marketing, Finance, and Sales teams to track KPIs, improve forecasting, provide training, and explore AI-driven automation opportunities to enhance sales and marketing efficiency.

In this role, you’ll not only administer and support Salesforce but also be the key owner of Certinia (FinancialForce) configuration and operations. You’ll ensure that our revenue, billing, and forecasting processes are accurate and scalable, and you’ll have the opportunity to expand your expertise by working closely with Intacct and other critical integrations.

If you’re someone who enjoys solving problems, improving efficiency, and enabling teams with better tools and insights, this is the perfect opportunity for you.

Responsibilities

  • Salesforce Administration : Configure fields, objects, page layouts, and record types; build and maintain workflows, flows, validation rules, approval processes, and customizations; manage system security: roles, profiles, permission sets, sharing rules, OWDs; troubleshoot user issues, provide support, and deliver training/documentation.
  • Certinia Administration : Configuration and ongoing support of FinancialForce processes (billing, forecasting, revenue recognition).
  • Systems Management : Monitor and maintain integrations, manage enhancements, and resolve issues (especially Certinia & Intacct).
  • Reporting & Analytics : Build dashboards, forecasts, campaign attribution, pipeline tracking, and ROI analysis.
  • Process Optimization : Document/refine sales processes, automate workflows, improve data quality.
  • Strategic Collaboration : Partner with Sales Ops, Marketing, Finance, and Customer Success to ensure KPIs are accurate and actionable.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, or equivalent experience.
  • At least 2 years of experience with direct Certinia/FinancialForce.
  • 3-5 years of proven experience as a Salesforce Administrator.
  • Hands-on expertise with Salesforce configuration and customization, including:
  • Workflows, Flows, and Process Builder automations.
  • Validation rules, approval processes, and assignment rules.
  • Reports, dashboards, and list views.
  • Security configuration (profiles, roles, permission sets, OWD, sharing rules).
  • Integration setup and troubleshooting with third-party tools (HubSpot, Certinia, Intacct, etc.).
  • Data management: imports, exports, deduplication, and maintaining data integrity.
  • Strong reporting/analytics skills (Salesforce Reports/Dashboards, Power BI a plus).
  • Ability to work cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Customer Success.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills with the ability to translate business requirements into system solutions.
  • Clear communicator, able to train and support users across functions.

Nice to have

  • Salesforce Administrator Certification(s).
  • Hands-on experience with Intacct (huge plus).
  • Experience with Finance/ERP integrations (Certinia, Intacct, or similar).
  • Exposure to AI tools, automation platforms, or agentic workflow technologies.
  • Familiarity with PandaDoc, Outreach, or Chorus.
  • Experience in SaaS or fast-scaling tech companies.

Benefits

We don’t call them perks; they’re just part of what makes working at Sparkrock great. Below are a couple of highlights:

  • We are 100% remote and global. Live your best life wherever that may be, and never lose out on career opportunities because of it.
  • Flexible work hours. We work asynchronously and don’t care when you’re online, just that you deliver great results and are there for our customers.
  • We are dedicated to your growth with consistent and meaningful feedback, support in achieving your personal career goals, and access to leading-edge tools, playbooks, and technology to amplify your experience.
  • Introductions to thought leaders in the space and webinars on cutting-edge tech hot topics.
  • Stipend to help set up your ideal home office.
  • Focus on culture: coffee chats, happy hours, cooking classes, book clubs, and more!

We strive to build a team that reflects the diversity of the community we work in and encourage applications from traditionally underrepresented groups such as women, visible minorities, Indigenous peoples, people identifying as LGBTQ2SI, veterans, and people with disabilities.

Sobre o Pensador

O Pensador.com, anteriormente conhecido como Pensador.info ou Pensador.uol.com.br, é propriedade da empresa 7Graus, que produz conteúdos para a América Latina e a Europa, com um escritório sediado em Portugal.

Com uma longa jornada de crescimento e melhorias contínuas, o site nasceu em 2005, a partir de uma lista de frases e citações. Percebendo que outras pessoas tinham o mesmo interesse, resolveu partilhar o seu acervo, de forma gratuita, com o resto do mundo.

Inicialmente, foi ele quem criou toda a estrutura do site. Hoje em dia, o Pensador é um dos maiores produtos da 7Graus, ajudando mais de 1 milhão de usuários diariamente. Para isso, contamos com uma equipe de especialistas e entusiastas que produzem, organizam e revisam os conteúdos.

Em 2023, decidimos levar a nossa missão mais longe e ampliar o âmbito do Pensador. Assim, nasceu o Pensador.com/es/, dedicado ao público falante de espanhol, que rapidamente tem conquistado novos leitores e amantes das letras. Em 2024, nasce o Pensador.com/en/, para o público que fala inglês. Em 2025 chegou o Mensagens de Aniversário, maior site de desejos de aniversário do Brasil.

description:
About us

About the role

Hello talented professionals! We’re expanding our pool of talent and invite skilled individuals to apply. While specific positions may not be available immediately, we’re proactively building a network of qualified candidates for future paid partnerships.

If you’re passionate about game development, eager to showcase and improve your skills on major titles, and open to potential partnerships down the line, we encourage you to apply and become part of our expert talent community. We look forward to connecting with you.

A 3D generalist is a multi-talented professional capable of managing various facets of the 3D production process, including modeling, texturing, lighting, rigging, animation, rendering, and compositing. They embody versatility, adaptability, and creativity, making them well-suited for diverse projects and genres.

Here's what you can expect

  • Profile preselection: Our Talent Acquisition team will review your profile to ensure it aligns with our requirements and values
  • Talent Acquisition Interview: Selected candidates will discuss their experience, skills, and fit for the role
  • Online Test: Qualified candidates will be invited to complete an online assessment
  • Technical Interview: Finalists will participate in a technical interview to assess proficiency and compatibility with our team when a project staffing plan is made

We’re committed to finding the best talent to join our growing team and look forward to connecting with you throughout this process.

The Quest

  • Concept interpretation : Translate 2D concepts and references into high-quality 3D models or sculpts with fidelity to the original design while adding necessary details to achieve leveling, style and craftsmanship with minimal direction.
  • High poly modeling and sculpting : Use industry-standard software to create detailed models that tell a story and meet artistic and technical requirements for the project.
  • Low poly and mid poly creation : Create game-ready versions with optimized topology, efficient UVs, and meeting technical requirements.
  • Textures creation : Use Photoshop and Substance Painter to create high-quality texture maps that accurately represent materials and align with project style.
  • Rigging and animation support : Collaborate with animators and riggers to prepare models for animation, providing clean topology and rig-friendly meshes, and help integrate animations into the game engine.
  • Optimization and performance : Optimize assets for performance and memory usage, implementing LODs and other techniques.
  • Asset integration : Export assets and integrate them in a game engine.
  • Efficient time management : Work efficiently to meet phase timelines and delivery dates.
  • Teamwork : Collaborate with other artists to solve problems and communicate about quality, technical, or delivery issues.
  • Punctuality : Present progress daily and/or when requested, and assist in meetings as needed.

The Skills

  • Strong polygonal modeling skills with clean, efficient, well-integrated and leveled models that meet project requirements.
  • Understanding of technical foundations to manage assets for memory and performance considerations.
  • Strong artistic sensibilities related to color theory, composition, scale, design, shape language, and craft basics, with understanding of proportions and industrial design.
  • PBR workflow and efficient/organized texture creation, with understanding of physically based workflows to achieve believable assets and story.
  • Familiarity with game engines such as Unity or Unreal Engine.
  • High degree of self-direction while being a team player with strong verbal and written communication, and openness to feedback.
  • Strong problem-solving abilities and proactive approach to technical and artistic challenges in 3D asset creation.
  • Strong knowledge of pipelines , workflows and asset exporting processes.
  • Quick learner of new processes and software as needed.
  • 3–5 years of experience in the video game industry and at least 3 credited games.

Software Expertise

  • Maya, 3ds Max, Blender or equivalent software
  • Unreal Engine 5 and Unity
  • ZBrush
  • Adobe Photoshop
  • Substance Painter
  • Substance Designer is a plus

Required Application Materials

  • Resume/CV
  • Cover letter
  • Reel or portfolio demonstrating the art and technical skills

The Reward

  • Competitive project-based compensation
  • Opportunity to work on exciting and diverse projects
  • Clear communication and support throughout the project duration
  • Flexibility in project timelines and deadlines
  • Potential for long-term collaboration on future projects
  • Transparent and fair evaluation of your work

This role oversees all aspects of network engineering, drives innovation, ensures operational excellence, and leads a team of network professionals. The Senior Network Lead partners with senior leadership to align network initiatives with business objectives and regulatory requirements, while fostering a culture of continuous improvement and collaboration. This is a hybrid role that includes people management responsibilities however, the majority of the role is hands-on: network engineering, troubleshooting, design, maintenance, and direct operational work.

You Will

Strategic Leadership & Planning

  • Develop and execute the network technology roadmap to support current and future business needs.
  • Lead cross-functional initiatives to modernize and secure network infrastructure across on-premises and cloud environments.
  • Provide technical leadership and guidance for large-scale network projects and migrations.

Network Architecture & Engineering Excellence

  • Oversee the design, implementation, and optimization of enterprise network solutions.
  • Ensure network architectures are secure, scalable, and aligned with industry best practices.
  • Evaluate and integrate emerging technologies to enhance performance, reliability, and security.

Operational Management & Support

  • Oversee advanced troubleshooting and resolution of complex network issues.
  • Manage critical incident response and root cause analysis.
  • Ensure high availability and reliability of network services through proactive monitoring and maintenance.

Security, Compliance & Risk Management

  • Define and enforce network security policies and controls.
  • Collaborate with the Security Team to address vulnerabilities and ensure compliance with regulatory standards (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA, PCI DSS).
  • Lead security assessments and remediation efforts.

Vendor, Stakeholder & Executive Engagement

  • Manage vendor relationships and negotiate contracts for network equipment and services.
  • Collaborate with senior leadership and business stakeholders to align network strategy with organizational goals.
  • Communicate network strategy, risks, and performance to executives in a clear and actionable manner.

Continuous Improvement & Innovation

  • Drive automation, process improvement, and operational efficiency initiatives.
  • Stay current with industry trends, emerging technologies, and regulatory changes.
  • Champion the adoption of best practices and innovative solutions across the organization.

Talent Management

  • Partner with the Talent and Infrastructure leadership teams in interviewing, hiring, and onboarding new team members.
  • Contribute to building a high-performing team by coaching others, sharing knowledge, and promoting skill development across infrastructure domains.
  • Advocate for a collaborative, inclusive, and transparent work culture that aligns with organizational values.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Must be available for on-call duty during peak periods, providing support outside of regular working hours as needed to ensure the timely resolution of critical issues.
  • Although we work in a remote-first environment, all roles requires in-person attendance at our headquarters approximately 2 times per year (in addition to other travel requirements for this specific role, if applicable). These visits are essential for team collaboration, strategic planning, and fostering deeper connections across the organization. Travel arrangements will be supported to ensure a seamless experience.

You Have

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field (or equivalent experience).

Required Certifications

  • Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA)
  • Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP)

Preferred Certifications

  • Microsoft Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900) - Must get within 90 days of employment
  • Microsoft Azure AI Fundamentals (AI-900) - Must get within 90 days of employment
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Network Engineer Associate (AZ-700)
  • Other relevant certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Advanced Networking, Juniper, Palo Alto, CISSP, CISM)

Experience

  • At least 7 years of progressive experience in network engineering
  • Minimum of 1 year supervising, mentoring, or leading technical teams; direct reporting experience preferred but not required.
  • Extensive experience designing and implementing enterprise network architectures.
  • Proven track record leading large-scale network projects and migrations.
  • Experience managing teams and developing talent.
  • Strong background in cloud networking (Azure, AWS) and hybrid environments.
  • Advanced troubleshooting skills across complex network environments.
  • Experience with network monitoring and management tools (e.g., SolarWinds, PRTG, Nagios, vRealize Operations).

Knowledge & Skills

  • Deep expertise in networking protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, BGP, OSPF, etc.).
  • Strong proficiency in firewall configuration, VPN technologies, and network security.
  • Familiarity with ITIL practices for incident, problem, and change management.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
  • Strong technical writing and documentation abilities.
  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to influence and collaborate at all levels of the organization.

Attributes

  • Strategic thinker with a focus on business outcomes and innovation.
  • Proactive, detail-oriented, and results-driven.
  • Adaptable and resilient in fast-paced, dynamic environments.
  • Committed to continuous learning and professional development.

title: Financial Crime Operations Analyst (LATAM Focus) - LEVEL 1
description:
About Reap

Reap is a global financial technology company headquartered in Hong Kong with employees across multiple countries. We enable financial connectivity and access for businesses worldwide by combining traditional finance with stablecoins for efficient money movement. Through our stablecoin-powered corporate cards, payments, and expense management tools, we streamline financial operations and help businesses scale. Our APIs enable businesses to integrate stablecoin-enabled finance into their own products and services, from issuing Visa cards to facilitating cross-border payments. Backed by leading investors including Index Ventures and HashKey Capital, Reap is building the future of borderless, stablecoin-enabled finance.

About The Team

We are looking for a passionate, detail-oriented and proactive Financial Crime Operations Analyst to join our Latam operations team. This role encompasses the full spectrum of financial crime prevention, including client onboarding and KYB screening, AML compliance, and broader financial crime risk management, ensuring we adhere to global regulatory standards.

In this role, you will drive operational excellence by streamlining onboarding and KYB processes, conducting comprehensive CDD and EDD, monitoring transactions for suspicious activities, and escalating potential fraudulent or sanction-related alerts. You will collaborate closely with compliance and regulatory teams to support risk assessments, enhance financial crime frameworks, and identify automation opportunities to streamline workflows.

You’ll be a key link between Reap Latam expansion efforts, headquarters operations, and our global compliance framework.

While Reap is headquartered in Hong Kong, and we have team members working remotely in LATAM.

This is a high-impact role for someone who thrives in a fast-paced fintech environment, embraces ambiguity, and takes ownership of both strategy and execution.

What You'll Do

You will own and drive end-to-end onboarding & AML operations across client lifecycle stages. Key responsibilities include:

  • Onboarding KYC/KYB Reviews: Conduct and sign off on due diligence for new and existing clients, including assessing complex corporate structures, international UBOs, and business models with higher-risk elements.
  • Periodic Reviews & Ongoing Monitoring: Lead ongoing due diligence checks and risk re-rating exercises, ensuring continued alignment with internal AML policies and evolving risk appetite.
  • Risk-Based Thinking & Data Analysis: Interpret and leverage data trends to identify potential policy gaps, process inefficiencies, or client behavioral red flags. Collaborate with analytics or product teams to refine rules and controls.
  • SOP Development, QA Involvement & Project Ownership: Drive the drafting and enhancement of SOPs, control checklists, and workflows in alignment with global AML/CTF policies. Partner with the QA team to ensure consistency and execution quality. You will also help design and implement the maker-checker (2-eye/4-eye) process, and serve as checker for escalated or sensitive cases.

Experience

What We're Looking For

Minimum 3 years of experience in onboarding operations, due diligence, or transaction monitoring, ideally with exposure to fintech, payments, EMIs/MSBs, cards, or regulated financial institutions. Proven end-to-end exposure to KYC/KYB and onboarding operations, with a strong track record of delivering high-quality service while meeting strict SLA standards.

AML Knowledge: Familiarity with global AML/CTF standards (e.g., FATF, CNBV, UIF, BCB, and other relevant Regulations in Mexico and Brazil).

Strategic Execution & Maker-Checker Design: Experience implementing or managing 2-eye/4-eye review frameworks, including performing the checker role on risk-sensitive cases. Experience in detecting and identifying patterns of unusual activity that lead to new types of unusual behavior.

Project Ownership: Strong ownership mindset, with the ability to lead and deliver small-to-medium AML projects and tasks. Comfortable coordinating across teams such as Product, Growth, Legal and Compliance, and Finance Ops.

Language Proficiency: Fluent in business English (spoken and written). Ability to read and speak Portuguese is a strong advantage (for candidates outside Brazil).

Artificial Intelligence Knowledge: Experience and knowledge using AI tools is a plus.

Overview

Piping Engineering & Analysis Synopsis

The Piping Engineering & Analysis discipline performs evaluations for piping systems in accordance with ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code, ASME B31.1, ASME B31.7, and other codes as applicable to the specific evaluation being performed. The Piping Engineering & Analysis discipline also performs the following specialty topics.

  • Vibration monitoring and analysis to evaluate system operational vibrations associated with plant modifications and operating events, and to provide vibration prevention and mitigation solutions and designs.
  • Evaluation of hydraulic transients, evaluation of piping systems for thermal stratification effects, operability evaluations, and qualification of piping for hydrodynamic loads.
  • Pipe rupture evaluations, evaluation of pipe wall thinning due to flow accelerated corrosion (FAC) or microbiological induced corrosion (MIC), and pipe flaw evaluations.

Position Details & Responsibilities

Position Specific Details

Provides senior level technical direction and supervision to the project team members in his/her discipline. Establishes project task schedules and budgets for his/her discipline to meet overall project requirements. Coordinates activities between disciplines. Is responsible for successful completion of project deliverables to meet all technical, quality, and project controls expectations. Serves as a technical liaison with the client and a lead technical resource on projects.

Lead engineers support engineering design projects with the following responsibilities:

  • Reviews complex calculations and approves simple calculations. Provides technical guidance to project team members. Ensures that calculations are technically sound and in accordance with project requirements.
  • Reviews and approves simple system/structural designs and prepares and reviews complex system/structural designs to ensure completeness, accuracy, quality, constructability, and operability.
  • Performs engineering review of drawings. Reviews design input for complex system/structures. Defines client expectations for drawings. Coordinates interface between design and engineering. Actively participates in design reviews to ensure quality, constructability, and operability.
  • Prepares and reviews major system, installation, and material specifications. Defines technical and commercial requirements, including scheduling of vendor submittals needed for design input.
  • Prepares bid evaluations for complex systems and installation scopes. Participates in bid negotiations with vendors. May evaluate change orders on behalf of the client.
  • Prepares and reviews single-discipline, complex reports/studies. Participates in the preparation of multi-discipline reports. Reviews studies and reports to ensure that conclusions are technically sound, cost-effective, and clearly communicated.

Qualifications

We do not sponsor employees for work authorization in the U.S. for this position.

Essential Skills and Experience:

  • BS or MS in Mechanical Engineering, Engineering Mechanics, Aerospace, or Structural/Civil Engineering, from an ABET Engineering Accreditation Commission-approved program, with an emphasis in solid mechanics, structural analysis, theory of elasticity, metallurgy, and finite element analysis
  • P.E. license
  • 10 or more years of relevant experience
  • Extensive knowledge of ASME B31.1 and ASME B&PV Section III piping codes
  • Knowledge of the design, selection, and application of pipe supporting elements
  • Working knowledge of commercially available piping products and their application
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

Valued but Not Required Skills and Experience:

  • The ability to navigate a 3D CAD model
  • Experience with AutoPIPE or PIPESTRESS software
  • Knowledge of gas dynamics and hydraulic transients
  • Knowledge of pipe condition assessment

Ready to own it, build it, and grow it?

About us:

We are Publitas! We’re a remote-first, fast-growing SaaS company helping brands turn static content into digital discovery experiences that drive results.

This role is for you if you…

  • Get excited by taking ownership and figuring things out proactively.

  • Thrive in a remote, async, fast-paced environment.

  • Are striving to deliver impact, not just running tasks.

  • Think in systems but execute with creativity.

  • Are direct, collaborative, and have a growth mindset

This role is NOT for you if you…

  • Need layers of process or someone to constantly tell you what to do.

  • Prefer “business as usual” over change.

  • Want a team where mediocre is okay.

  • Have never worked remotely and think async means “lonely”

  • Are waiting for permission instead of taking initiative.

  • Helping us maintain and improve our platform's performance, stability, and scalability.

  • Contributing to our backend architecture and strategy.

  • You have several years of experience building web applications in Ruby on Rails and other technologies and frameworks. Our backend is mostly Ruby on Rails with a bit of Node.js.

  • You can work back from the problem domain towards technical solutions, making technical decisions and breaking problems into manageable chunks on the way.

  • You have experience releasing, maintaining, and scaling a SaaS product on the public cloud. Our product runs on AWS.

  • You're a strong, written and verbal communicator, very fluent, and comfortable with English. You can explain technical concepts and help bring consensus within the team.

  • It’s a bonus if you have experience with our frontend technologies, React and Redux, and can build simple things end-to-end.

  • It is an extra advantage if you have experience with data pipelines and data modeling using technologies like Apache Spark. As well as experience or an affinity with DevOps technologies, such as Infrastructure As Code.

What We Provide to Help You Win…

  • A competitive salary

  • 25 vacation days + your local national holidays

  • A top-tier MacBook and remote-ready gear

  • Monthly wellness budget to invest in your health

  • Co-Working allowance

  • Events, training, or courses that directly and primarily contribute to your work at Publitas

  • Free books on Kindle and Audible

  • Free Publitas Swag (merchandise)

How to apply…

We don’t ask for CVs or cover letters. Why? Because they rarely tell us who you are or what you’re truly great at.

Instead, we ask smart questions and give you a chance to show us what you’d bring to the role.

No fluff. Just real insight into what it’s like to work together.

title: Front End Developer - Remote
description:
EventMobi is an all-remote company and this is a fully remote position, open to all candidates globally as long as you are able to work in eastern standard time zone.

Why You Should Join Us

EventMobi is an award-winning tech scale-up with thousands of clients across the globe. We believe that live events bring people together to enable change, for businesses and society at large. At EventMobi we have a huge impact on enabling success for events and their attendees. We are on a mission to revolutionize how event planners create, market and manage their events and how attendees experience conferences and tradeshows.

How We Build

If you're passionate about shaping the future of web applications and event technology, join us. We build high-performance React-based web and mobile experiences using tools like ReactQuery, Capacitor, Material UI, Vite/Webpack—and increasingly, AIpowered tooling to boost developer productivity and reliability.

What Your Work Will Focus On

  • Modern Web App Development: Collaborate with the team to enhance our responsive progressive web platform—working on offline caching, real-time UI updates, and scalable architecture.
  • Feature Development: Participate in planning, implementing, and testing user-facing features in collaboration with product and design.
  • Contribute to Architecture: Engage in technical discussions and help shape the evolution of our app framework.
  • Quality & Reliability: Write maintainable code and contribute to a robust and performant application experience.
  • AIassisted development: Learn and explore tools like GitHub Copilot, Augment, Claude, or other LLM-based assistants for code generation, documentation, and debugging.

Your Qualifications

  • 3–5 years of experience building user-facing software products
  • 2+ years working with JavaScript/TypeScript and React
  • Experience working with REST APIs, JSX, modern HTML/CSS
  • Familiarity with design systems (Material UI, Ant Design, etc.)
  • Experience writing and maintaining tests using Jest, React Testing Library
  • Comfortable debugging common issues in the codebase
  • Excellent communication: clear, asynchronous collaboration in English

NICE TO HAVE

  • Strong use of typed TypeScript across React hooks and components
  • Proficiency with ReactQuery or similar libraries for API integration
  • Mobile/app development experience via Capacitor, Cordova, or React Native
  • Docker, AWS, and CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, etc.)
  • Experience with TypeScript across React hooks and components
  • Familiarity with ReactQuery or similar libraries for API integration
  • Mobile/app development exposure (Capacitor, Cordova, or React Native)
  • Exposure to Docker, AWS, or CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions)
  • Understanding of SOLID principles, domain modeling, or design patterns

What You Will Get From EventMobi

  • Compensation: Base salary ranges from $40k to $65k CAD depending on experience
  • Time-Off: 2-weeks PTO + 3-summer days + your birthday is a holiday (seriously! log-off and hang out with the fam or go do something fun) + opportunities to meet your co-workers in person throughout the year
  • Tools: Top of the line hardware and the best collaboration software for remote work so you can be as productive as possible while working from home
  • The Best Coworkers Ever: If you ask anyone that has worked at EventMobi, they will tell you that their fellow Mobiers are the best part of their experience! Don’t underestimate the positive impact of caring co-workers have on your everyday happiness.

Remote Workspace Requirements

  • You have a safe, comfortable, and ergonomic workspace and working environment - a private and quiet workspace is a vital requirement for doing your best work!
  • You have a reliable internet connection capable of participating in video calls, with at least 30Mbps download speed

About EventMobi

We're focused on building the most comprehensive event management platform to help conference organizers create engaging event experiences. We believe live events bring people together and enable positive change. Over 30,000+ events in 70+ countries from major brands such as Porche and Shoppers Drug Mart, to amazing non-profits such as American Psychiatric Nurses Association and Canadian Real Estate Association have trusted EventMobi’s suite of software technology to manage their events and engage their attendees.

If you are interested in seeing EventMobi in action, check out some of the videos below:

  • The Experience Manager Platform
  • The EventMobi Mobile Event App
  • The Product Tour
  • Top brands and organizations from around the world have used EventMobi’s event app technology to create incredible event experiences - hear directly from our customers.

EventMobi is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.
